Introducing the perfect addition to your tea time routine - The Tea Spot Tech Teaware Black White Ceramic 2 Piece Infuser Mug Cup. This tea strainer is designed to make your life easier and your tea taste better. The ceramic material ensures that it is durable and reusable, making it perfect for all occasions. The blue color adds a touch of elegance to your tea time decor.

This tea infuser is perfect for those who love tea and want to enjoy it in style. The two-piece design allows you to infuse your tea leaves without any hassle. The Tech Teaware model is designed to make your tea time experience even more enjoyable. Made in China, this tea strainer is a must-have for all tea lovers out there.
